headline: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
summary: Apple developed a custom AI model for the China market. This model was trained with support from Chinese tech giant Alibaba. It's a rare cross-border tech partnership amidst rising tensions.

headline: Help build a monument to that ‘sad little bitch’ Elon Musk
summary: Cards Against Humanity is crowdfunding a monument to "annoy Elon Musk." They plan to build it on their land near Starbase, Texas. The project is launched with the company's characteristic vulgar humor.

headline: Trump declares 100 percent tariffs on many drones and all aircraft parts
summary: Donald Trump is proposing 100% tariffs on numerous imported drones. The tariffs would also apply to all aircraft parts. This policy targets existing drone imports and parts, making them significantly more expensive.

headline: Apple and Epic argue over how much Apple should get from purchases made outside the App Store
summary: Apple proposes collecting fees on digital purchases made via external links. This is part of their ongoing legal dispute with Epic Games. Epic claims Apple's fee request is "far outside of the bounds" of previous rulings.

headline: Magic: The Gathering's The Hobbit Booster Boxes Secure a New Price Cut on Launch Day
summary: Amazon is offering discounted MTG The Hobbit Play Booster Boxes. The price cut coincides with the set's launch day. The article guides on finding the deal and the set's most valuable cards.

headline: The X-Files Creator Chris Carter Wants to Continue the Story on From the Divisive Season 11 Finale
summary: Chris Carter, The X-Files creator, wants to continue the show's story. He aims to resolve threads from the divisive Season 11 finale. IGN interviewed Carter about plans for the series' future.

headline: Xbox's Separation from Compulsion Games Seems Complete as Studio Is Listed as the Publisher of South of Midnight on Steam
summary: Xbox's separation from Compulsion Games appears complete. Compulsion Games is now listed as the publisher for South of Midnight on Steam. This follows Xbox spinning out four studios during a recent 'reset.'

headline: Never Run Out of Ports Again With This Sabrent 8-Port 252W USB Charging Station, Now Just $59.60
summary: A Sabrent 8-Port 252W USB Charging Station is currently available for $59.60. This deal provides an affordable solution for multiple device charging. The station offers ample ports to prevent running out of charging options.

headline: Farage's by-election victory won't stop questions about finances
summary: Nigel Farage secured a predictable by-election victory in Clacton. Despite the win, questions regarding his finances are expected to persist. The article discusses the broader implications and achievements of his victory.

headline: Watch: Video shows scale of devastation in Stourbridge
summary: Video footage reveals the extensive devastation in Stourbridge. Multiple fires tore through the West Midlands on Thursday. Firefighters are continuing to work to control the ongoing blazes.

headline: Eurovision proposes new rules to tackle mass voting
summary: Eurovision organizers are proposing new rules to combat mass voting practices. They find politically motivated voting "persistent" and "deeply worrying." The changes aim to ensure fairness and integrity in the competition.

headline: The Office's Lucy Davis 'overwhelmed' by kindness after cancer diagnosis
summary: Lucy Davis, known for 'The Office,' is overwhelmed by public kindness. This outpouring of support follows her recent cancer diagnosis. Davis revealed she is living with incurable cancer.
